---
name: Skill admission request
about: Propose adding or updating an upstream skill in the registry
title: '[SKILL] '
labels: ['skill-proposal']
assignees: ''
---

**Skill Identifier**
e.g. `fastapi-production-patterns`

**Upstream Source Repository**
Link to the official repository (e.g. `https://github.com/tiangolo/fastapi`)

**License**
What open-source license does the upstream repository use? (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-3-Clause)

**Pinned Commit SHA**
The exact full git commit SHA to pin:

**Target Bundle or Profile**
Which focused bundle or profile should include this skill? (e.g. `bus-backend-api-data`)

**Skill Purpose & Quality Rationale**
Why should this skill be admitted? How does it adhere to the Authority Hierarchy and avoid context bloat?

**Supply Chain Verification Checklist:**
- [ ] License is OSI-approved and compatible.
- [ ] Pinned commit is verified and immutable.
- [ ] Zero secret leaks or unvetted commands.
- [ ] Does not create unresolvable conflicts with existing framework authorities.
